subject: BrightBridge invoice consolidation, PO mapping and payment terms
messages:
From: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@brightbridgehealth.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Lee <marcus.lee@brightbridgehealth.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 05 Sep 2026 09:14:00 +0000
Subject: Invoice cadence & PO field mapping requirements for BrightBridge BW-01 contract

Hi Jonas,

Thanks for the demo this week. Procurement and our ERP team asked me to confirm a few billing constraints before we move to final signatures:

- We need a consolidated invoice at month-end that includes separate line items for each legal entity (BB-UK Ltd and BB-Services GmbH).
- Each invoice must include an official PO number per entity (format: BB-<entity>-YYYY-######) and a purchase order PDF attached.
- Net45 payment terms are required for this vendor relationship.
- Invoice PDFs must include the following fields explicitly: billing contact, remit-to address, VAT registration number, and an invoice reference matching our ERP posting rules.
- We prefer payments via our lockbox; can Redwood provide payee name and account details (or an ACH/IBAN) on the invoice?

Also: does Redwood support automated EDI/ERP posting (we use Workday) or a simple field mapping/CSV export we can ingest?

If any of these are blockers, call them out now so our legal/procurement can adjust. Otherwise we will route the PO and payment matrix once we get a final invoice example and PO field mapping.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — Elena
Elena Ruiz
Senior Procurement Manager | BrightBridge Health
elena.ruiz@brightbridgehealth.com
+44 20 7123 4455

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@brightbridgehealth.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 05 Sep 2026 13:01:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Invoice cadence & PO field mapping requirements for BrightBridge BW-01 contract

Hi Elena — thanks for laying this out, and great meeting earlier. Quick answers up front, then next steps below.

Summary answers:
- Consolidated month-end invoice: yes, we can provide a single PDF that contains separate sections per legal entity and attach separate per-entity invoice PDFs if you prefer.
- PO number requirement: we require a PO reference on the invoice; we can map to your BB-<entity>-YYYY-###### format. Please confirm exact field name to map ("PO Number" vs "Customer PO").
- Net45: Redwood standard is net30. We can accept net45 on approved enterprise contracts; requires a signed agreement addendum and we will route to finance for credit terms.
- Invoice fields: we can include billing contact, remit-to, VAT, and ERP reference fields.
- Lockbox/Payment details: we can expose our payment instructions on the invoice (IBAN/ACH) and support a lockbox address for mailed checks.
- EDI/ERP integration: we do not currently support full EDI out-of-the-box for Workday but we provide a CSV/JSON export and a configurable field mapping template that your ERP team can ingest. We also offer a managed onboarding for high-volume customers to produce a flat-file that maps directly into Workday.

Attached I’ve included: 1) redwood_sample_invoice.pdf (example month-end consolidated invoice with entity sections), and 2) po_field_map_template.xlsx (a simple mapping table we ask your ERP team to confirm).

Next steps (proposal):
1) Confirm field name you want populated for the PO (exact string).
2) Procurement signs the PO and returns an initial single-entity PO for testing; we’ll push a test invoice for validation.
3) If you require net45, please sign the attached payment-terms addendum (I can route to legal) — once approved finance will provision the net45 term.
4) If multiple legal entities require separate invoices for accounting, we recommend using consolidated PDF + per-entity attached PDFs for the first 3 months to validate posting.

If you’re open to a small commercial concession for the additional billing complexity (multi-entity invoices + net45), we can discuss an early-payment discount or tiered credit. Happy to sync with Vanessa and our finance lead next week.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Account Executive, Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com | +44 7700 900123

Date: Mon, 07 Sep 2026 08:47:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Invoice cadence & PO field mapping requirements for BrightBridge BW-01 contract

Thanks, Jonas. A couple follow-ups from our ERP/invoicing team after reviewing the sample invoice:

- For our month-end reconciliation we need separate invoice numbers per legal entity (not just sections). Can Redwood output individual PDFs for BB-UK Ltd and BB-Services GmbH, each with its own invoice number, and also produce a single combined cover PDF that lists totals?
- We will be issuing a single blanket PO across entities during the pilot phase. Can Redwood accept a PO that references multiple entity IDs and still route invoices correctly to the specific legal entity?
- Regarding net45: procurement is flexible but legal will only allow net45 if there is a 60-day early payment discount window (e.g., pay within 30 days for 1.5% discount). Is Redwood able to support an early-pay discount dynamically on invoices?
- Does Redwood support a lockbox/third-party payment processing address for GBP/EUR?

We’d like to lock the billing approach before the contract signature next week. If we can get confirmation and a short addendum that shows the net45 + early-pay discount option we can finalize.

Thanks — Marcus
Marcus Lee
ERP Program Manager | BrightBridge Health
marcus.lee@brightbridgehealth.com

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 07 Sep 2026 15:32:00 +0000
Subject: FW: Invoice cadence & PO field mapping requirements for BrightBridge BW-01 contract

Folks — forwarding BrightBridge asks and our sample invoice. Key negotiation points I want to align on before we go back:

1) Net45 request + early-pay discount: they want net45 but legal requires an early-pay window that yields a discount (example: 1.5% if paid within 30 days). Finance will need to approve. My read: we can offer a 30/1.5% early-pay tradeoff (we already run early-pay discounts programmatically) but need sign-off for this customer given deal size (DB-78321).

2) Entity-level invoices + cover PDF: product can generate per-entity PDFs with unique invoice numbers and a consolidated cover PDF. Implementation work: small templating change and UI flag; ops needs to confirm SLA impact (slightly more tokenized generation).

3) PO mapping across entities: we can accept a blanket PO but need a matching table showing which PO lines map to which legal entity; the external team must provide that mapping in the provided po_field_map_template.xlsx.

4) Lockbox/IBAN: finance can provide IBAN/ACH details and a lockbox address for checks. For GBP/EUR lockbox routing we should confirm with banking ops.

Commercial ask: Marcus asked implicitly for an early-pay discount in exchange for net45. I propose we offer a 1.5% early-pay discount (30-day pay) with net45 by addendum, rather than a flat percent off list prices. This preserves list price while giving procurement what they need. If you both agree I’ll draft the addendum and route to legal.

Please reply with: APPROVE / REQUEST MODIFICATION / DECLINE.

Thanks,
Jonas
